worldcombat.skill.reversal.summary: A last-ditch thrust: plant, gather your remaining strength, leap along your aim and burst a fighting fan in front of you that damages and shoves every foe inside it outward. The closer you are to fainting, the heavier the blow and the longer the fan's reach; enemies behind you are never hit.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.use.0: Turn a low HP bar into one big counter-blow
worldcombat.skill.reversal.use.1: Throw open everything pressing in from the front
worldcombat.skill.reversal.use.2: Reckless form: gamble on a heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.reversal.description.0: The fan deals about %1$s contact damage to each enemy inside it, once each; the closer you are to fainting the heavier the thrust. Defence, type match-up and criticals settle per target.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.description.1: Plant for %1$s ticks (interruptible — nothing happens if interrupted), then leap up to %2$s blocks along your aim at %3$s blocks per tick; entering the fan's reach makes it erupt early.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.description.2: The landing throws open a fan in front of you of about %1$s blocks in reach and %2$s degrees wide (the more wounded, the farther and wider); every enemy inside is shoved outward from the centre about %3$s blocks, while those immune to displacement still take the hit. The leap probes ahead with a %4$s block radius and erupts early on an obstacle.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.reckless.on: Reckless form: the burst's power is ×1.18, but if it lands on at least one enemy you pay %1$s of your maximum health in recoil once; recovery is 2 ticks longer and cooldown 8 ticks longer, so it can drop you while hurt.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.reckless.off: Not reckless: no recoil, no ×1.18 power, and recovery and cooldown stay at their base values.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s ticks of planting it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.preference.re: On: power ×1.18, but if the burst lands on at least one enemy you pay 8% of your maximum health in recoil, with 2 ticks more recovery and 8 ticks more cooldown; stronger but riskier while hurt. Off: no recoil.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of leaping. Larger values chase harder.
When your health ratio is not above this value the move becomes a primary option that outranks other attacks and scales further with your wounds; lower it so only greater danger prioritises it.
On: raise priority further when the target is below about a third health. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to burst. Off: it only bursts when the target is already in reach.
